why: Lane session_013NEJKzXJPDWrSRe3i1fGJd (#1593) met a refusal whose text comes from the Claude Code harness's worktree isolation, not from a claude-settings guard: a grep of main finds nothing (coordinator, 04:44 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: none — the refusal text is the Claude Code harness's worktree isolation, not a claude-settings guard (grep of main finds nothing). Until: 2026-11-21. Raise it upstream.
